rationale: The primary-source incident directly supports the claimed semantic-only CI blind spot and catastrophic regex complexity failure. However, the packet itself recognizes that fairness requires explicit accepted semantics and a resource budget, yet supplies neither a defined grammar/corpus contract nor a numeric deterministic work limit. Thus candidate acceptance would depend on verifier-hidden requirements. The task is otherwise natural, the verifier-owned corpus and work counter provide structural isolation, and adversarial resource-complexity enforcement is novel against the supplied baseline. Cheap-probe falsifiability is also uncertain because its stated falsifier is logically incomplete and no concrete budget is registered.
